description: A player is returning from injury, and the team must remember which activities are fully cleared, limited, or still off-limits across practices and matches. All team and athlete names are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 36-year-old athletic trainer coordinating return-to-play boundaries with coaches
user_profile.context: The athlete feels ready to do more, but the current clearance boundaries are nuanced and easy to oversimplify
user_profile.communication_style: Boundary-oriented and cautious, wants permissions tied to concrete activity types

fact_sheet.fact: The player's full name is Kai Tanaka.
Kai Tanaka's jersey number for Northwood FC is 10.
Kai Tanaka's position is attacking midfielder.
Kai Tanaka's unique identifier in the team's medical system is KT-10.
The specific injury is a complete tear of the right Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL).
The injury occurred on October 15, 2023, during a match against the Bayview Strikers.
ACL reconstruction surgery was performed by Dr. Anya Sharma on October 28, 2023.
The lead athletic trainer managing the return-to-play protocol is Dr. Elena Vance.
The external physical therapist coordinating with the team is Ben Carter from Pinnacle Performance Therapy.
The current protocol is officially designated 'RTP Protocol KT-10-ACL-Phase4'.
This phase of the protocol is active from May 15, 2024, to June 15, 2024.
Kai Tanaka is fully cleared for all non-contact warm-up exercises with the team.
Kai Tanaka is fully cleared for stationary passing and shooting drills without any defensive pressure.
Kai Tanaka is fully cleared for straight-line running drills up to 80% of his maximum sprint speed.
Kai Tanaka is fully cleared for solo weight training focusing on upper body and core.
Participation in small-sided possession drills, such as 5v2 rondos, is limited to a maximum of 15 minutes per practice session.
Agility ladder drills are limited to forward-facing movements only; no lateral shuffles are permitted.
Jumping drills, including box jumps, are limited to a maximum box height of 18 inches.
Lower body weight training is limited to 60% of his pre-injury one-rep max for squats and deadlifts.
Long-distance passing drills over 30 yards are limited to 10 repetitions per session to manage load.
All activities involving contact with other players during practice are categorized as 'Off-Limits'.
All drills involving full-speed, multi-directional cutting are categorized as 'Off-Limits'.
Participation in full-squad 11-vs-11 scrimmages is categorized as 'Off-Limits'.
Kai Tanaka is categorized as 'Off-Limits' for all official match play, including friendly matches.
Kai Tanaka is not permitted to be listed on the official substitute bench for any matches until the next protocol review.
Kai Tanaka is cleared to participate in pre-match warm-ups, but must be excluded from full-squad tactical drills.
Daily pain levels for the right knee must be reported on a 1-10 scale; any report above a 3 requires immediate activity cessation.
Dr. Elena Vance must log Kai Tanaka's daily training load and subjective feedback into the 'AthleteMonitoring' software platform.
Any visible swelling of the right knee must be measured and photographed, with data uploaded to the 'TeamMed' shared drive within 2 hours of observation.
A bi-weekly progress report must be sent via email to Head Coach Marcus Thorne and Dr. Anya Sharma.
The designated Slack channel for daily coordination of Kai Tanaka's training plan is #kai-tanaka-rtp.
Any deviation from the RTP protocol requires verbal and written approval from Dr. Elena Vance.
Head Coach Marcus Thorne must confirm receipt of all protocol updates via email.
Kai Tanaka is required to wear a 'DonJoy Defiance III' custom knee brace during all on-field activities.
